Container.Name: roon-playlist-automation
Container.Overview:
Automatically maintains playlists in Roon from Pitchfork Best New Music and Aquarium Drunkard's Spotify playlists. Roon's API cannot create playlists, so this syncs picks into a Qobuz (or TIDAL) playlist, which Roon then imports from your linked streaming account.
Setup (Qobuz — default, simplest): just fill in QOBUZ_USERNAME and QOBUZ_PASSWORD (your normal Qobuz account). No developer accounts needed — the Qobuz app id is auto-discovered, and Aquarium Drunkard's playlists are found automatically from their Spotify profile. Start the container and you're done.
To use TIDAL instead: set PROVIDER=tidal and see the TIDAL_CLIENT_ID field and the project's UNRAID.md for the one-time login step.
Syncs on start and then every LOOP_INTERVAL_HOURS.

Config.Name: Data (tokens and sync state)
Config.Description: Stores credentials/tokens and which tracks were already added.

Config.Name: QOBUZ_USERNAME
Config.Description: Your Qobuz account email. No developer signup needed - the app id is auto-discovered.

Config.Name: QOBUZ_PASSWORD
Config.Description: Your Qobuz account password.

Config.Name: AD_SPOTIFY_PLAYLIST_IDS
Config.Description: Optional. Leave blank to auto-discover Aquarium Drunkard's playlists from their Spotify profile. Set to a comma-separated list of playlist IDs (the part after /playlist/ in a share link) to pick specific ones instead.

Config.Name: PROVIDER
Config.Description: Where the playlists are created: qobuz or tidal.

Config.Name: SPOTIFY_CLIENT_ID
Config.Description: Needed for Aquarium Drunkard AUTO-DISCOVERY, and for the official Spotify API. Create a free app at developer.spotify.com/dashboard. Without it, auto-discovery is off and you must set AD_SPOTIFY_PLAYLIST_IDS manually (those are still read without an account).

Config.Name: SPOTIFY_CLIENT_SECRET
Config.Description: Spotify app client secret (see SPOTIFY_CLIENT_ID).

Config.Name: AD_MAX_PLAYLISTS
Config.Description: How many of Aquarium Drunkard's most recent playlists to mirror when auto-discovering.

Config.Name: AD_NAME_FILTER
Config.Description: Optional regex; only auto-discovered AD playlists whose name matches are mirrored (e.g. 'Radio Free' for the monthly mixtape).

Config.Name: AD_SPOTIFY_USER
Config.Description: Spotify user whose playlists are auto-discovered.

Config.Name: AD_AUTO_DISCOVER
Config.Description: Auto-find AD playlists from their Spotify profile when AD_SPOTIFY_PLAYLIST_IDS is blank.

Config.Name: LOOP_INTERVAL_HOURS
Config.Description: Hours between syncs.

Config.Name: PITCHFORK_ENABLED
Config.Description: Maintain the Pitchfork Best New Music playlists.

Config.Name: PITCHFORK_INCLUDE_TRACKS
Config.Description: Maintain a Best New Tracks playlist.

Config.Name: PITCHFORK_INCLUDE_ALBUMS
Config.Description: Maintain a Best New Albums playlist (separate from tracks).

Config.Name: PITCHFORK_TRACKS_PLAYLIST_NAME
Config.Description: Name of the Best New Tracks playlist.

Config.Name: PITCHFORK_ALBUMS_PLAYLIST_NAME
Config.Description: Name of the Best New Albums playlist.

Config.Name: PITCHFORK_ALBUM_MODE
Config.Description: How Best New Albums are added: 'tracks' = a separate playlist of each album's tracks (recommended); 'favorite' = add whole albums to your streaming Favorites/library (one shared collection).

Config.Name: PITCHFORK_MAX_TRACKS_PER_ALBUM
Config.Description: In 'tracks' album mode, cap tracks added per album (0 = all).

Config.Name: AD_ENABLED
Config.Description: Maintain the Aquarium Drunkard playlist.

Config.Name: AD_PLAYLIST_NAME
Config.Description: Name of the Aquarium Drunkard playlist.

Config.Name: COUNTRY_CODE
Config.Description: TIDAL catalog country code (PROVIDER=tidal only).

Config.Name: TIDAL_CLIENT_ID
Config.Description: Only for PROVIDER=tidal. Client ID from developer.tidal.com/dashboard (add redirect URI http://127.0.0.1:8976/callback to the app).

Config.Name: TIDAL auth callback port
Config.Description: Only used during the one-time TIDAL 'auth-tidal' login.

Config.Name: QOBUZ_APP_ID
Config.Description: Optional override; normally auto-discovered from the Qobuz web player.
